intermediate.title: Red Bull KM Sprint | Sauk (112 km)

story: The 2025 Giro started in Albania with a five-rider early breakaway. The group was caught with 40 kilometres remaining. Under the pace set by Lidl-Trek, the peloton thinned out on the final climbs, leaving many sprinters behind. Mads Pedersen then won the sprint from a reduced peloton.
